fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-11-10, around 09:40, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 4,50,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-11-12. The online submission was made by Padmini Sri (9000000119). Abirami Sri (9000000096) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint refers to Meena Sekar, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000196. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100016 as the destination of the transfer. The complaint mentions Hariharan Babu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000154, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00256, as the mobile number 9000000154 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Funds reportedly routed through a chain of accounts.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, shopping complex, suspect, mobile number, witness, receiving account, associate
